# PC Anatomy

> PC Anatomy is a free, open-source 3D computer anatomy learning resource. Explore an interactive 3D computer model, learn what PC components do, and see how to assemble a desktop PC.

## Start here

- [Interactive 3D computer explorer](https://pc-anatomy.brickshow.site/explore): Explore the computer system, inspect components in 3D, and open the related hardware learning guides.
- [Desktop PC assembly guide](https://pc-anatomy.brickshow.site/assembly): General step-by-step instructions for assembling a desktop PC.

## Component learning guides

- [PC case](https://pc-anatomy.brickshow.site/components/pc-case): How the chassis houses components, supports airflow, and affects compatibility.
- [CPU](https://pc-anatomy.brickshow.site/components/cpu): Processor functions, cores, clock speed, cache, and socket compatibility.
- [Motherboard](https://pc-anatomy.brickshow.site/components/motherboard): Board functions, sockets, chipset, memory, PCIe, storage, and form factors.
- [RAM](https://pc-anatomy.brickshow.site/components/ram): Working memory, capacity, speed, generations, and performance.
- [GPU](https://pc-anatomy.brickshow.site/components/gpu): Graphics processing, VRAM, integrated graphics, and PC compatibility.
- [Storage overview](https://pc-anatomy.brickshow.site/components/storage): SSDs, HDDs, SATA, NVMe, capacity, and storage versus RAM.
- [SATA SSD](https://pc-anatomy.brickshow.site/components/ssd): Flash storage, SATA interfaces, and drive use in a PC.
- [M.2 SSD](https://pc-anatomy.brickshow.site/components/m2-ssd): M.2 form factors, NVMe, PCIe lanes, and compatibility.
- [HDD](https://pc-anatomy.brickshow.site/components/hdd): Magnetic storage, platters, capacity, and common use cases.
- [Power supply](https://pc-anatomy.brickshow.site/components/power-supply): AC-to-DC conversion, wattage, connectors, and protection.
- [CPU cooler](https://pc-anatomy.brickshow.site/components/cpu-cooler): Air and liquid cooling, heat transfer, and CPU temperatures.
- [Case fans](https://pc-anatomy.brickshow.site/components/case-fans): Case airflow, intake and exhaust, pressure, and fan sizing.
- [Keyboard](https://pc-anatomy.brickshow.site/components/keyboard): Keyboard switches, input signals, layouts, and connection types.
- [Mouse](https://pc-anatomy.brickshow.site/components/mouse): Mouse sensors, movement tracking, buttons, and connectivity.
- [Monitor](https://pc-anatomy.brickshow.site/components/monitor): Display panels, refresh rate, resolution, and video connections.
- [UPS](https://pc-anatomy.brickshow.site/components/ups): Battery backup, runtime, and protection during power interruptions.
- [AVR](https://pc-anatomy.brickshow.site/components/avr): Automatic voltage regulation and protection from voltage variation.
